name: Details & Column-Sort Integrity Workflow
description: Verifies the Details tab filters and column sorting, and that each column header sorts by its own field.

planSteps.description: Assert the table headers read Name / PID / Status / User name / CPU / Memory / Threads
Assert the list sorts by CPU% descending
Assert the list sorts by Memory descending
Assert the list sorts by username
Assert the list sorts by thread count (Running rows first)
Type a PID into the filter field
Assert only that PID row remains
